Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her upper arms held against her sides, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains, her legs pressed together, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
extreme platform pumps carved from the same wenge wood, extra long nails in matching polished wenge wood.
